text: (Written) 子どもは家に{{c1::帰るが早いか::帰る · the instant (が早いか)}}、外へ遊びに行った。
tr: The instant the child got home, he went out to play.
notes: Dictionary form / past + が早いか: the instant A happened, B (almost at the same moment). Narrative; not about your own will.
tip: や否や and なり are close in meaning. なり often has an unexpected B.

text: (Written) ベルが{{c1::鳴るが早いか::鳴る · the instant (が早いか)}}、学生たちは教室を飛び出した。
tr: The instant the bell rang, the students dashed out of the classroom.
notes: Dictionary form / past + が早いか: the instant A happened, B (almost at the same moment). Narrative; not about your own will.
tip: や否や and なり are close in meaning. なり often has an unexpected B.

text: (Written) 彼はそのニュースを{{c1::聞くや否や::聞く · as soon as (や否や)}}、部屋を出ていった。
tr: As soon as he heard the news, he left the room.
notes: Dictionary form + や否や (or just や): as soon as (B follows immediately).

text: (Written) 新商品は{{c1::発売されるや否や::発売される · as soon as (や否や)}}、売り切れた。
tr: The new product sold out as soon as it was released.
notes: Dictionary form + や否や (or just や): as soon as (B follows immediately).

text: (Written) 彼女は私の顔を{{c1::見るなり::見る · as soon as (なり)}}、泣き出した。
tr: As soon as she saw my face, she burst into tears.
notes: Dictionary form + なり: as soon as (and then something unexpected). Only about other people, not yourself.
tip: vs が早いか: なり stresses that B was surprising.

text: (Written) 父は{{c1::帰ってくるなり::帰ってくる · as soon as (なり)}}、寝てしまった。
tr: My father went straight to bed the moment he got home.
notes: Dictionary form + なり: as soon as (and then something unexpected). Only about other people, not yourself.
tip: vs が早いか: なり stresses that B was surprising.

text: 単語を{{c1::覚えるそばから::覚える · no sooner … than (repeatedly)}}、忘れてしまいます。
tr: No sooner do I learn a word than I forget it.
notes: Dictionary form / past + そばから: no sooner … than (it keeps happening, over and over).

text: 片付ける{{c1::そばから::no sooner … than (repeatedly)}}、子どもが散らかします。
tr: As soon as I tidy up, the kids make a mess again.
notes: Dictionary form / past + そばから: no sooner … than (it keeps happening, over and over).

text: 子どもが{{c1::生まれてからというもの::生まれる · ever since (big change)}}、生活がすっかり変わりました。
tr: Ever since our child was born, our life has completely changed.
notes: て-form + からというもの: ever since (a big change, and it has continued).
tip: vs て以来: てからというもの stresses how big the change is.

text: 彼女に{{c1::出会ってからというもの::出会う · ever since (big change)}}、毎日が楽しいです。
tr: Ever since I met her, every day has been fun.
notes: て-form + からというもの: ever since (a big change, and it has continued).
tip: vs て以来: てからというもの stresses how big the change is.

text: 今日{{c1::を限りに::as of (last time)}}、たばこをやめます。
tr: As of today, I'm quitting smoking.
notes: Time noun + を限りに: as of (this is the last time).

text: 本日{{c1::を限りに::as of (last time)}}、閉店いたします。
tr: We are closing for good as of today.
notes: Time noun + を限りに: as of (this is the last time).

text: 東京公演{{c1::を皮切りに::starting with}}、全国ツアーが始まります。
tr: The national tour begins with a show in Tokyo.
notes: Noun + を皮切りに: starting with (the first of a series).

text: 彼の発言{{c1::を皮切りに::starting with}}、次々と反対意見が出ました。
tr: Starting with his remark, one objection followed another.
notes: Noun + を皮切りに: starting with (the first of a series).

text: 彼は会社に{{c1::勤めるかたわら::勤める · while also (main + side)}}、小説を書いています。
tr: Alongside his office job, he writes novels.
notes: Dictionary form / noun + の + かたわら: while also (a side activity alongside your main work, over a long period).
tip: vs ながら: ながら is two actions at the same moment.

text: 彼女は子育ての{{c1::かたわら::while also}}、大学で勉強しています。
tr: While raising children, she's also studying at university.
notes: Dictionary form / noun + の + かたわら: while also (a side activity alongside your main work, over a long period).
tip: vs ながら: ながら is two actions at the same moment.

text: 散歩{{c1::がてら::while (on the way)}}、パンを買いに行きます。
tr: I'll get some bread while I'm out for a walk.
notes: Verb stem / noun + がてら: while (doing A, also do B; on the way).

text: 駅まで客を{{c1::送りがてら::送る · while (on the way)}}、買い物をしてきました。
tr: I did some shopping while seeing a guest off at the station.
notes: Verb stem / noun + がてら: while (doing A, also do B; on the way).

text: 大学生{{c1::ともなれば::once one becomes}}、自分のことは自分でするべきです。
tr: Once you're a university student, you should look after yourself.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + ともなると / ともなれば: once it comes to (a higher level, where things are naturally different).

text: 十二月{{c1::ともなると::once it gets to}}、街はにぎやかになります。
tr: Once it's December, the streets get lively.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + ともなると / ともなれば: once it comes to (a higher level, where things are naturally different).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: (Written) 貧しさ{{c1::ゆえに::because of (formal)}}、彼は学校に行けなかった。
tr: Because of poverty, he couldn't go to school.
notes: Noun / plain form + ゆえ(に) (ゆえの + noun): because of (formal, written).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: (Written) 若さ{{c1::ゆえの::because of (+ noun)}}失敗だった。
tr: It was a mistake born of youth.
notes: Noun / plain form + ゆえ(に) (ゆえの + noun): because of (formal, written).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 連休{{c1::とあって::because (special occasion)}}、道路はどこも込んでいます。
tr: Because it's a long weekend, the roads are busy everywhere.
notes: Noun / plain form + とあって: because (a special situation, so naturally…).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 人気歌手が来る{{c1::とあって::because (special occasion)}}、会場は若者でいっぱいでした。
tr: With a popular singer coming, the venue was packed with young people.
notes: Noun / plain form + とあって: because (a special situation, so naturally…).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 子どもを{{c1::愛していればこそ::愛している · precisely because}}、厳しくするのです。
tr: It's precisely because I love my child that I'm strict.
notes: ば-form + こそ: precisely because (positive reason, emphasised).
tip: vs からこそ: same meaning; ばこそ is more literary.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 健康で{{c1::あればこそ::ある · precisely because}}、仕事ができるのです。
tr: It's only because you're healthy that you can work.
notes: ば-form + こそ: precisely because (positive reason, emphasised).
tip: vs からこそ: same meaning; ばこそ is more literary.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 子どもの{{c1::手前::in front of (saving face)}}、泣くわけにはいきません。
tr: I can't cry in front of the children.
notes: Noun + の / plain form + 手前: since (in front of others; to save face, I can't…).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 行くと{{c1::言った手前::言う · having said (saving face)}}、今さら断れません。
tr: Having said I'd go, I can't back out now.
notes: Noun + の / plain form + 手前: since (in front of others; to save face, I can't…).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: (Formal) 慣れぬ{{c1::こととて::because (formal excuse)}}、ご迷惑をおかけしました。
tr: Being unused to it, I'm afraid I caused you trouble.
notes: Plain form + こととて: because (a formal excuse or apology).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: (Formal) 子どものした{{c1::こととて::because (formal excuse)}}、どうかお許しください。
tr: As it was done by a child, please forgive it.
notes: Plain form + こととて: because (a formal excuse or apology).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 仕事{{c1::にかこつけて::using … as an excuse}}、飲み会を断りました。
tr: I used work as an excuse to get out of the drinks.
notes: Noun + にかこつけて: using X as an excuse (or pretext).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 出張{{c1::にかこつけて::using … as an excuse}}、観光を楽しみました。
tr: I used the business trip as an excuse to do some sightseeing.
notes: Noun + にかこつけて: using X as an excuse (or pretext).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 本日{{c1::をもって::as of (formal)}}、受付を終了いたします。
tr: Applications close as of today.
notes: Noun + をもって: (a) as of (a formal time); (b) by means of (formal).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 結果は書面{{c1::をもって::by means of (formal)}}、ご連絡いたします。
tr: We will inform you of the results in writing.
notes: Noun + をもって: (a) as of (a formal time); (b) by means of (formal).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 子どものため{{c1::とあれば::if it's for}}、どんなことでもします。
tr: If it's for my children, I'll do anything.
notes: Noun / plain form + とあれば: if it's (for X, I'll do whatever it takes).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 社長の命令{{c1::とあれば::if it's}}、従うしかありません。
tr: If it's the president's order, I have no choice but to obey.
notes: Noun / plain form + とあれば: if it's (for X, I'll do whatever it takes).

text: 今から{{c1::急いだところで::急ぐ · even if (futile)}}、間に合いません。
tr: Even if we hurry now, we won't make it.
notes: Past た + ところで: even if (it would be pointless).
tip: vs ても: たところで stresses that it's futile.

text: いくら{{c1::説明したところで::説明する · even if (futile)}}、彼にはわからないでしょう。
tr: However much you explain, he won't understand.
notes: Past た + ところで: even if (it would be pointless).
tip: vs ても: たところで stresses that it's futile.

text: 子ども{{c1::といえども::even (a …)}}、ルールは守らなければなりません。
tr: Even children have to follow the rules.
notes: Noun + といえども: even (a …); though one may be.

text: 専門家{{c1::といえども::even (a …)}}、間違えることはあります。
tr: Even experts sometimes get things wrong.
notes: Noun + といえども: even (a …); though one may be.

text: 春{{c1::とはいえ::although (that said)}}、まだ寒い日が続いています。
tr: It may be spring, but the cold days continue.
notes: Noun / plain form + とはいえ: although; that said.

text: 仕事が忙しい{{c1::とはいえ::although}}、連絡くらいはできるはずです。
tr: Busy as you are, you should at least be able to get in touch.
notes: Noun / plain form + とはいえ: although; that said.

text: 誰{{c1::であれ::no matter who}}、規則は守らなければなりません。
tr: Whoever you are, you must follow the rules.
notes: Question word / noun + であれ / であろうと: no matter (who / what); whatever it is.

text: 理由が何{{c1::であろうと::no matter what}}、暴力は許されません。
tr: Whatever the reason, violence is not acceptable.
notes: Question word / noun + であれ / であろうと: no matter (who / what); whatever it is.

text: 雨が{{c1::降ろうが降るまいが::降る · whether or not}}、試合は行います。
tr: Rain or no rain, the match will go ahead.
notes: Volitional + が + dictionary form + まいが: whether or not. Volitional + と: no matter (how / what).

text: 人に何と{{c1::言われようと::言われる · no matter (what)}}、自分の道を進みます。
tr: Whatever people say, I'll go my own way.
notes: Volitional + が + dictionary form + まいが: whether or not. Volitional + と: no matter (how / what).

text: 早く{{c1::言えばいいものを::言う · if only (regret)}}、どうして黙っていたんですか。
tr: You should have just said so; why did you keep quiet?
notes: Plain form + ものを: if only (regret, or criticism of what someone failed to do).

text: (Written) 薬を飲めば治る{{c1::ものを::if only (criticism)}}、彼は飲もうとしない。
tr: He'd get better if he just took the medicine, but he won't.
notes: Plain form + ものを: if only (regret, or criticism of what someone failed to do).

text: 子ども{{c1::ならいざしらず::would be one thing, but}}、大人がそんなことをするなんて。
tr: From a child it'd be one thing, but for an adult to do that…
notes: Noun + ならいざしらず: X would be one thing, but (this case is unacceptable).

text: 初めて{{c1::ならいざしらず::would be one thing, but}}、三回目なのにまだ間違えるんですか。
tr: If it were your first time, fine, but you're still getting it wrong on the third try?
notes: Noun + ならいざしらず: X would be one thing, but (this case is unacceptable).

text: 兄{{c1::にひきかえ::in contrast to}}、弟はよく勉強します。
tr: Unlike his older brother, the younger one studies hard.
notes: Noun + にひきかえ: in contrast to (with a judgement: one is better, the other worse).
tip: vs に比べて: neutral comparison.

text: 去年の暑さ{{c1::にひきかえ::in contrast to}}、今年の夏は涼しいです。
tr: Compared with last year's heat, this summer is cool.
notes: Noun + にひきかえ: in contrast to (with a judgement: one is better, the other worse).
tip: vs に比べて: neutral comparison.

text: 周囲の反対{{c1::をよそに::disregarding}}、彼は会社を辞めました。
tr: Ignoring everyone's objections, he quit the company.
notes: Noun + をよそに: disregarding (others' concern, expectations or opposition); carrying on regardless.
tip: vs にもかかわらず: a neutral 'despite', without the sense of deliberately ignoring.

text: 親の心配{{c1::をよそに::disregarding}}、息子は毎晩遊び歩いています。
tr: Ignoring his parents' worries, the son goes out every night.
notes: Noun + をよそに: disregarding (others' concern, expectations or opposition); carrying on regardless.
tip: vs にもかかわらず: a neutral 'despite', without the sense of deliberately ignoring.

text: 彼は大けが{{c1::をものともせずに::undaunted by}}、試合に出場しました。
tr: Undaunted by a serious injury, he played in the match.
notes: Noun + をものともせずに: undaunted by; in defiance of (hardship). Used about others' bravery.

text: 嵐{{c1::をものともせずに::undaunted by}}、船は港を出ました。
tr: Undaunted by the storm, the ship left port.
notes: Noun + をものともせずに: undaunted by; in defiance of (hardship). Used about others' bravery.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text:
京都{{c1::ならでは::ならでは or だけあって?}}の味を楽しみました。
プロ{{c2::だけあって::ならでは or だけあって?}}、さすがに上手です。
tr: We enjoyed a flavour only Kyoto can offer. / As you'd expect from a professional, it's really good.
notes: Noun + ならでは(の): something only N can offer (always praise). だけあって: as you'd expect, given (a reputation or effort).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: これは手作り{{c1::ならでは::ならでは or だけあって?}}の温かさです。
tr: This is a warmth only handmade things have.
notes: Noun + ならでは(の): something only N can offer (always praise). だけあって: as you'd expect, given (a reputation or effort).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: この仕事を任せられるのは、彼{{c1::をおいて::apart from (no one else)}}ほかにいません。
tr: There's no one but him I can trust with this job.
notes: Noun + をおいて + ほかにない: apart from X (there's no one / nothing else).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 次のリーダーは、あなた{{c1::をおいて::apart from (no one else)}}考えられません。
tr: I can't imagine anyone but you as the next leader.
notes: Noun + をおいて + ほかにない: apart from X (there's no one / nothing else).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 疲れたときは、寝る{{c1::に限ります::is the best (thing)}}。
tr: When you're tired, sleep is the best thing.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + に限る: X is the best (thing to do).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 夏はビール{{c1::に限ります::is the best}}ね。
tr: In summer, nothing beats beer.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + に限る: X is the best (thing to do).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 毎日とは{{c1::言わないまでも::言う · even if not (at least)}}、週に一回は運動したほうがいいです。
tr: Not necessarily every day, but you should exercise at least once a week.
notes: ない form + までも: even if not (as far as X), at least Y.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 優勝は{{c1::できないまでも::できる · even if not (at least)}}、決勝には進みたいです。
tr: Even if we can't win, I want to at least reach the final.
notes: ない form + までも: even if not (as far as X), at least Y.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 努力{{c1::なくして::without (formal)}}、成功はありません。
tr: There's no success without effort.
notes: Noun + なくして(は) + negative: without X (Y is impossible; formal).
tip: vs なしに: なしに is just 'without doing'; なくして stresses X is essential.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 皆様のご協力{{c1::なくしては::without (formal)}}、この計画は実現できませんでした。
tr: This project could not have happened without your cooperation.
notes: Noun + なくして(は) + negative: without X (Y is impossible; formal).
tip: vs なしに: なしに is just 'without doing'; なくして stresses X is essential.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 彼は断り{{c1::なしに::without}}、私の部屋に入ってきました。
tr: He came into my room without asking.
notes: Noun + なしに / dictionary form + ことなしに: without (doing).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 努力する{{c1::ことなしに::without doing}}、夢はかなえられません。
tr: You can't achieve your dreams without making an effort.
notes: Noun + なしに / dictionary form + ことなしに: without (doing).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 彼にお金を{{c1::貸したが最後::貸す · once (and it's over)}}、絶対に返ってきません。
tr: Once you lend him money, you'll never see it again.
notes: Past た + が最後: once you do X, that's it (a bad result you can't undo).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: この本は{{c1::読み始めたが最後::読み始める · once (and it's over)}}、やめられなくなります。
tr: Once you start this book, you won't be able to put it down.
notes: Past た + が最後: once you do X, that's it (a bad result you can't undo).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: そんなことは{{c1::言わずとも::言う · even without}}わかっています。
tr: I know that without you having to say it.
notes: ない form without ない + ずとも: even without (doing).
tip: vs なくても: the same meaning; ずとも is literary.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: {{c1::急がずとも::急ぐ · even without}}、間に合います。
tr: We'll make it even without hurrying.
notes: ない form without ない + ずとも: even without (doing).
tip: vs なくても: the same meaning; ずとも is literary.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: 友達がみんな帰ってしまって、{{c1::さびしい限りです::さびしい · I feel so …}}。
tr: All my friends have gone home; I feel so lonely.
notes: い-adj / な-adj + な + 限りだ: I feel so …; extremely (the speaker's own emotion).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::04 Exclusivity, conditions and limits
text: こんな賞をいただけて、{{c1::うれしい限りです::うれしい · I feel so …}}。
tr: I'm absolutely delighted to receive this award.
notes: い-adj / な-adj + な + 限りだ: I feel so …; extremely (the speaker's own emotion).

text: 彼の態度は{{c1::失礼極まりない::失礼 · extremely (formal)}}です。
tr: His attitude is extremely rude.
notes: な-adj / noun + 極まりない (or 極まる): extremely (formal, usually negative).

text: こんな夜中に電話するなんて、{{c1::迷惑極まりない::迷惑 · extremely (formal)}}話です。
tr: Calling in the middle of the night is incredibly inconsiderate.
notes: な-adj / noun + 極まりない (or 極まる): extremely (formal, usually negative).

text: このような賞をいただき、{{c1::光栄の至りです::光栄 · the height of}}。
tr: It is a great honour to receive such an award.
notes: Noun + の至り: the height of (fixed phrases: 光栄の至り, 若気の至り).

text: あれは{{c1::若気の至り::若気 · the height of}}でした。
tr: That was the folly of youth.
notes: Noun + の至り: the height of (fixed phrases: 光栄の至り, 若気の至り).

text: 一人で夜道を歩いたときの怖さ{{c1::といったらありませんでした::indescribable (past)}}。
tr: Walking home alone at night was indescribably scary.
notes: Noun + といったらない / といったらありません: indescribably; beyond words.

text: 試合に勝ったときのうれしさ{{c1::といったらありません::indescribable}}。
tr: The joy of winning the match was beyond words.
notes: Noun + といったらない / といったらありません: indescribably; beyond words.

text: その番組はひどくて、{{c1::見るにたえない::見る · can't bear to}}内容でした。
tr: The programme was terrible; it was unwatchable.
notes: (a) 見る / 聞く + にたえない: too awful to see / hear. (b) 感謝 / 同情 + にたえない: I can't express how deeply I feel (formal).

text: 皆様のご支援には{{c1::感謝にたえません::感謝 · deeply (formal)}}。
tr: I am deeply grateful for your support.
notes: (a) 見る / 聞く + にたえない: too awful to see / hear. (b) 感謝 / 同情 + にたえない: I can't express how deeply I feel (formal).

text: 今年は去年{{c1::にもまして::even more than}}暑いです。
tr: This year is even hotter than last year.
notes: Noun + にもまして: even more than. 何にもまして: more than anything.

text: 何{{c1::にもまして::more than anything}}、健康が大切です。
tr: More than anything, health matters.
notes: Noun + にもまして: even more than. 何にもまして: more than anything.

text: 彼は百キロ{{c1::からある::as much as (large amount)}}荷物を一人で運びました。
tr: He carried a load weighing a good hundred kilos by himself.
notes: Number + からある / からの: as much as; as many as (stressing a large amount).

text: 一万人{{c1::からの::as many as (+ noun)}}人が集まりました。
tr: As many as ten thousand people gathered.
notes: Number + からある / からの: as much as; as many as (stressing a large amount).

text: 一円{{c1::たりとも::not even (one)}}無駄にできません。
tr: I can't waste even a single yen.
notes: One + counter + たりとも + negative: not even one.

text: 一日{{c1::たりとも::not even (one)}}練習を休んだことはありません。
tr: I've never missed practice, not even once.
notes: One + counter + たりとも + negative: not even one.

text: 彼は自分の名前{{c1::すら::even}}書けません。
tr: He can't even write his own name.
notes: Noun + すら: even (a basic thing). だに is literary, mainly in 想像するだに / 考えるだに (just thinking about it…).
tip: vs さえ: すら is the more written equivalent.

text: 地震のことは、{{c1::想像するだに::想像する · even (just)}}恐ろしいです。
tr: Just imagining an earthquake is terrifying.
notes: Noun + すら: even (a basic thing). だに is literary, mainly in 想像するだに / 考えるだに (just thinking about it…).
tip: vs さえ: すら is the more written equivalent.

text: 彼は四十歳{{c1::にして::at (only then)}}、初めて結婚しました。
tr: He married for the first time at forty.
notes: Noun + にして: (a) only at (that level) did; (b) even (someone that capable).

text: この問題は、専門家{{c1::にして::even (an expert)}}解けないそうです。
tr: Apparently even experts can't solve this problem.
notes: Noun + にして: (a) only at (that level) did; (b) even (someone that capable).

text: 電車がないなら、歩いて帰る{{c1::までです::I'll just (have to)}}。
tr: If there are no trains, I'll just walk home.
notes: Dictionary form + までだ: I'll just (have to) do it (no other option). Past + までのことだ: I merely did it (nothing more to it).

text: 聞かれたから答えた{{c1::までのことです::merely (that's all)}}。
tr: I only answered because I was asked.
notes: Dictionary form + までだ: I'll just (have to) do it (no other option). Past + までのことだ: I merely did it (nothing more to it).

text: いくらお金があっても、{{c1::死んでしまえばそれまでです::死んでしまう · that's the end}}。
tr: However much money you have, once you're dead, that's it.
notes: ば-form + それまでだ: once X happens, that's the end of it (it's all pointless).

text: 高いカメラも、{{c1::使わなければそれまでです::使う · it's pointless if not}}。
tr: Even an expensive camera is pointless if you don't use it.
notes: ば-form + それまでだ: once X happens, that's the end of it (it's all pointless).

text:
(Written, effect on the audience) 彼の演技は観客を感動させ{{c1::ずにはおかない::ずにはおかない or ずにはいられない?}}。
(Your own reaction) その話を聞いて、感動せ{{c2::ずにはいられませんでした::ずにはおかない or ずにはいられない?}}。
tr: His performance can't fail to move the audience. / Hearing that story, I couldn't help being moved.
notes: ずにはおかない: (a thing or event) inevitably makes others feel or do something; or a strong resolve. ずにはいられない: I can't help (my own urge).

text: (Written) この映画は見る人を考えさせ{{c1::ずにはおかない::ずにはおかない or ずにはいられない?}}。
tr: This film can't fail to make its viewers think.
notes: ずにはおかない: (a thing or event) inevitably makes others feel or do something; or a strong resolve. ずにはいられない: I can't help (my own urge).

text: 人の物を壊したのだから、{{c1::弁償せずにはすまない::弁償する · can't get away without}}でしょう。
tr: You broke someone's property, so you'll have to pay for it.
notes: ない form without ない + ずにはすまない (する → せずには): can't get away without (the situation demands it).
tip: vs ずにはいられない: an inner urge; ずにはすまない: a social obligation.

text: こんなミスをしたら、部長に{{c1::報告せずにはすみません::報告する · can't get away without}}。
tr: With a mistake like this, I can't get away without reporting it to the manager.
notes: ない form without ない + ずにはすまない (する → せずには): can't get away without (the situation demands it).
tip: vs ずにはいられない: an inner urge; ずにはすまない: a social obligation.

text: 被害者の話には、同情{{c1::を禁じ得ません::can't help (feeling, formal)}}。
tr: I can't help feeling sympathy for the victims.
notes: Noun (feeling) + を禁じ得ない: can't help feeling (formal; 同情, 怒り, 驚き).

text: その判決には、怒り{{c1::を禁じ得ません::can't help (feeling, formal)}}。
tr: I can't help feeling angry at that verdict.
notes: Noun (feeling) + を禁じ得ない: can't help feeling (formal; 同情, 怒り, 驚き).

text: 台風のため、試合は中止{{c1::を余儀なくされました::was forced (by circumstances)}}。
tr: The match had to be cancelled because of the typhoon.
notes: Noun + を余儀なくされる: be forced to (by circumstances beyond your control).

text: 彼は病気で、入院{{c1::を余儀なくされました::was forced (by circumstances)}}。
tr: His illness forced him into hospital.
notes: Noun + を余儀なくされる: be forced to (by circumstances beyond your control).

text: 夢を{{c1::実現するべく::実現する · べく / べからず / べくもない}}、毎日努力しています。
tr: I work hard every day to make my dream come true.
notes: べく: in order to (written). べからず: must not (signs, rules). べくもない: there's no way to (can't even hope).
tip: する → すべく / すべからず also common.

text: (A sign) 芝生に{{c1::入るべからず::入る · べく / べからず / べくもない}}。
tr: Keep off the grass.
notes: べく: in order to (written). べからず: must not (signs, rules). べくもない: there's no way to (can't even hope).
tip: する → すべく / すべからず also common.

text: 彼の実力には、私など{{c1::及ぶべくもありません::及ぶ · べく / べからず / べくもない}}。
tr: I couldn't hope to match his ability.
notes: べく: in order to (written). べからず: must not (signs, rules). べくもない: there's no way to (can't even hope).
tip: する → すべく / すべからず also common.

text: 彼女の悲しみは{{c1::想像にかたくありません::想像 · not hard to}}。
tr: It's not hard to imagine her sorrow.
notes: 想像 / 察する + にかたくない: it isn't hard to (imagine / understand).

text: 親の苦労は{{c1::察するにかたくありません::察する · not hard to}}。
tr: It's easy to understand what the parents went through.
notes: 想像 / 察する + にかたくない: it isn't hard to (imagine / understand).

text: 彼は{{c1::信頼に足る::信頼 · worthy of}}人物です。
tr: He is a person worthy of trust.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + に足る: worthy of. 取るに足りない: not worth bothering about.

text: それは{{c1::取るに足りない::取る · not worth}}問題です。
tr: That's a trivial issue.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + に足る: worthy of. 取るに足りない: not worth bothering about.

text: 皆様のご健康を{{c1::願ってやみません::願う · never cease to (formal)}}。
tr: I sincerely wish you all good health.
notes: て-form + やまない: never cease to (wish, love, hope; formal, about deep feelings).

text: ここは彼が{{c1::愛してやまない::愛する · never cease to}}故郷です。
tr: This is the hometown he never stopped loving.
notes: て-form + やまない: never cease to (wish, love, hope; formal, about deep feelings).

text: 彼は物事を大げさに{{c1::言うきらいがあります::言う · tend to (bad habit)}}。
tr: He has a tendency to exaggerate.
notes: Dictionary form / noun + の + きらいがある: tend to (an undesirable tendency).
tip: vs がち: がち is about frequency; きらいがある is about character.

text: この会社は、新しいことを避ける{{c1::きらいがあります::tend to (bad habit)}}。
tr: This company tends to avoid anything new.
notes: Dictionary form / noun + の + きらいがある: tend to (an undesirable tendency).
tip: vs がち: がち is about frequency; きらいがある is about character.

text: 彼は遅刻ばかりして、ついには会社を{{c1::クビになるしまつです::クビになる · ended up (bad)}}。
tr: He was always late, and in the end he got fired.
notes: Dictionary form + しまつだ: end up (after a series of bad things, finally this).

text: 弟は勉強もせず、とうとう{{c1::留年するしまつです::留年する · ended up (bad)}}。
tr: My brother never studied and has ended up having to repeat a year.
notes: Dictionary form + しまつだ: end up (after a series of bad things, finally this).

text: あの二人が結婚する{{c1::とは::to think that}}、思いもしませんでした。
tr: I never imagined those two would get married.
notes: Plain form + とは: to think that… (surprise or shock).
tip: vs なんて (N3): more casual.

text: こんな所で会う{{c1::とは::to think that}}、驚きました。
tr: Fancy meeting you here!
notes: Plain form + とは: to think that… (surprise or shock).
tip: vs なんて (N3): more casual.

text:
彼女は今にも{{c1::泣き出さんばかり::泣き出す · んばかり or とばかりに?}}の顔をしていました。
「待ってました」{{c2::とばかりに::んばかり or とばかりに?}}、子どもたちが走ってきました。
tr: She looked as if she were about to burst into tears. / The children came running, as if to say 'We've been waiting!'
notes: ない form without ない + んばかり: almost (as if about to). Quote + とばかりに: as if to say '…'.

text: 厳しい状況{{c1::にあって::in (a situation)}}、彼はよくがんばりました。
tr: In a tough situation, he did well.
notes: Noun + にあって: in (a particular situation or position).
tip: vs において: において is a neutral 'in / at'.

text: 社長という立場{{c1::にあって::in (a position)}}、そんな発言は許されません。
tr: In the position of president, such a remark is unacceptable.
notes: Noun + にあって: in (a particular situation or position).
tip: vs において: において is a neutral 'in / at'.

text: 事実{{c1::に即して::in accordance with}}、報告書を書いてください。
tr: Please write the report based strictly on the facts.
notes: Noun + に即して: in accordance with (facts, rules, the actual situation).

text: 法律{{c1::に即して::in accordance with}}、判断します。
tr: We will decide in accordance with the law.
notes: Noun + に即して: in accordance with (facts, rules, the actual situation).

text: 結果{{c1::いかんで::depending on}}、次の計画を決めます。
tr: We'll decide the next plan depending on the results.
notes: Noun + (の) いかんで: depending on. Noun + の + いかんによらず / いかんにかかわらず: regardless of.

text: 理由の{{c1::いかんによらず::regardless of}}、遅刻は認めません。
tr: Lateness will not be accepted, whatever the reason.
notes: Noun + (の) いかんで: depending on. Noun + の + いかんによらず / いかんにかかわらず: regardless of.

text: 前回の反省{{c1::をふまえて::taking into account}}、計画を立て直しました。
tr: Taking last time's lessons into account, we redrew the plan.
notes: Noun + をふまえて: taking into account; building on.

text: 調査の結果{{c1::をふまえて::taking into account}}、対策を考えます。
tr: We'll consider measures based on the survey results.
notes: Noun + をふまえて: taking into account; building on.

text: 彼は漢字{{c1::はおろか::let alone}}、ひらがなも書けません。
tr: He can't write hiragana, let alone kanji.
notes: Noun + はおろか + (even more basic thing) + も / さえ + negative: let alone; not to mention.
tip: vs どころか: どころか also covers 'the opposite is true'.

text: 旅行{{c1::はおろか::let alone}}、近所に出かける時間もありません。
tr: I don't even have time to pop out locally, let alone travel.
notes: Noun + はおろか + (even more basic thing) + も / さえ + negative: let alone; not to mention.
tip: vs どころか: どころか also covers 'the opposite is true'.

text: {{c1::見るともなく::見る · without really meaning to}}テレビを見ていました。
tr: I was watching TV without really paying attention.
notes: Dictionary form + ともなく: without really meaning to; idly. Question word + (から / に) + ともなく: from somewhere / someone (vaguely).

text: どこから{{c1::ともなく::(from) somewhere, vaguely}}、いい香りがしてきました。
tr: A lovely smell drifted in from somewhere.
notes: Dictionary form + ともなく: without really meaning to; idly. Question word + (から / に) + ともなく: from somewhere / someone (vaguely).

text: 法律{{c1::に照らして::in light of}}判断すると、彼は無罪です。
tr: Judged against the law, he is not guilty.
notes: Noun + に照らして: in light of; measured against (rules, precedent).

text: 過去の例{{c1::に照らして::in light of}}考えると、この方法は危険です。
tr: In light of past cases, this method is risky.
notes: Noun + に照らして: in light of; measured against (rules, precedent).

text: これは命{{c1::にかかわる::affecting (serious)}}問題です。
tr: This is a matter of life and death.
notes: Noun + にかかわる: affecting; involving (something serious: life, reputation).

text: 会社の信用{{c1::にかかわる::affecting (serious)}}ことなので、慎重に対応してください。
tr: It affects the company's reputation, so please handle it carefully.
notes: Noun + にかかわる: affecting; involving (something serious: life, reputation).

text: 好天{{c1::と相まって::combined with}}、会場は多くの人でにぎわいました。
tr: Helped by the good weather, the venue was crowded.
notes: Noun + と相まって: combined with (two factors reinforcing each other).

text: 美しい音楽{{c1::と相まって::combined with}}、映画はさらに感動的になりました。
tr: Combined with the beautiful music, the film became even more moving.
notes: Noun + と相まって: combined with (two factors reinforcing each other).

tr: This child had a gift for music from birth.
notes: Noun / verb stem + ながらに(して): while still; (just) as one is (生まれながらに = from birth; 涙ながらに = in tears).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state

tr: With the internet, you can talk to people all over the world without leaving home.
notes: Noun / verb stem + ながらに(して): while still; (just) as one is (生まれながらに = from birth; 涙ながらに = in tears).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text:
この作文は{{c1::まちがいだらけ::まちがい · だらけ / まみれ / ずくめ}}です。
彼は{{c2::汗まみれ::汗 · だらけ / まみれ / ずくめ}}になって働きました。
今年は{{c3::いいことずくめ::いいこと · だらけ / まみれ / ずくめ}}の一年でした。
tr: This essay is full of mistakes. / He worked until he was drenched in sweat. / This year was nothing but good things.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: 彼はいつも{{c1::黒ずくめ::黒 · だらけ / まみれ / ずくめ}}の服を着ています。
tr: He always dresses all in black.
notes: だらけ: full of (many unpleasant things). まみれ: covered in (a liquid or powder, on the surface). ずくめ: entirely (all one colour; nothing but good things).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: 日差しが{{c1::春めいて::春 · showing signs of}}きました。
tr: The sunshine is beginning to feel like spring.
notes: Noun + めく (めいた + noun): showing signs of; -like.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: 彼の言い方には{{c1::皮肉めいた::皮肉 · tinged with}}ところがあります。
tr: There's something a bit sarcastic in the way he talks.
notes: Noun + めく (めいた + noun): showing signs of; -like.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: (Written) 時間は矢の{{c1::ごとく::like (literary)}}過ぎていく。
tr: Time flies like an arrow.
notes: Noun + の + ごとく / ごとき + noun: like; as (literary version of ように / ような).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: (Written) 彼の{{c1::ごとき::like (+ noun, literary)}}人物は、めったにいない。
tr: People like him are rare.
notes: Noun + の + ごとく / ごとき + noun: like; as (literary version of ように / ような).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: 教師{{c1::たる::as one who is}}者、生徒の手本にならなければなりません。
tr: As a teacher, you must set an example for the students.
notes: Noun + たる + noun (者 / もの): as one who is (and should behave accordingly).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: 政治家{{c1::たる::as one who is}}もの、約束は守るべきです。
tr: A politician should keep their promises.
notes: Noun + たる + noun (者 / もの): as one who is (and should behave accordingly).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: 私{{c1::なりに::in my own way}}、がんばってみました。
tr: I did my best, in my own way.
notes: Noun + なりに / なりの + noun: in one's own way (within one's limits).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: 子どもには子ども{{c1::なりの::in their own way (+ noun)}}考えがあります。
tr: Children have their own way of thinking.
notes: Noun + なりに / なりの + noun: in one's own way (within one's limits).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: 彼はいつも{{c1::偉ぶって::偉い · acting as if}}います。
tr: He's always acting superior.
notes: い-adj without い / noun + ぶる: put on airs; act as if (negative).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::08 Manner, appearance and state
text: 彼女は{{c1::上品ぶって::上品 · acting as if}}いますが、本当は違います。
tr: She acts all refined, but she isn't really.
notes: い-adj without い / noun + ぶる: put on airs; act as if (negative).
tip: vs ふりをする: neutral 'pretend'.

tr: Isn't this plan unrealistic?
notes: Plain form + のではあるまいか: isn't it the case that…? (formal speculation).
tip: Spoken equivalent: のではないだろうか.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: (Written) 彼は本当のことを知っているの{{c1::ではあるまいか::isn't it the case that (written)}}。
tr: Couldn't it be that he knows the truth?
notes: Plain form + のではあるまいか: isn't it the case that…? (formal speculation).
tip: Spoken equivalent: のではないだろうか.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 条件によっては、{{c1::引き受けないものでもありません::引き受ける · not impossible}}。
tr: Depending on the terms, I might be willing to take it on.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 急げば、{{c1::間に合わないものでもありません::間に合う · not impossible}}。
tr: If we hurry, we might just make it.
notes: ない form + ものでもない: it's not impossible; I could (if pushed).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 彼の努力は{{c1::評価されてしかるべきです::評価される · ought to (proper)}}。
tr: His efforts deserve recognition.
notes: て-form + しかるべきだ: ought to; it would only be proper.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 会社から社員に説明が{{c1::あってしかるべきです::ある · ought to (proper)}}。
tr: The company really ought to explain this to its staff.
notes: て-form + しかるべきだ: ought to; it would only be proper.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 成功したのは、皆様のご協力{{c1::にほかなりません::nothing other than}}。
tr: Our success is due to nothing other than your cooperation.
notes: Noun + にほかならない: is nothing other than; is none other than.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 彼の厳しさは、愛情の表れ{{c1::にほかなりません::nothing other than}}。
tr: His strictness is nothing but a sign of love.
notes: Noun + にほかならない: is nothing other than; is none other than.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 参加者は五十人{{c1::といったところです::about (at most)}}。
tr: There were around fifty participants at most.
notes: Noun / plain form + といったところだ: about; at most (not a lot).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 私の英語は、日常会話ができる{{c1::といったところです::about (at most)}}。
tr: My English is about good enough for everyday conversation.
notes: Noun / plain form + といったところだ: about; at most (not a lot).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 結局、彼女には{{c1::会えずじまい::会える · ended up never}}でした。
tr: In the end I never got to see her.
notes: ない form without ない + ずじまい: ended up never doing (and the chance has passed).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 買った本を{{c1::読まずじまい::読む · ended up never}}になっています。
tr: I bought the book and never got round to reading it.
notes: ない form without ない + ずじまい: ended up never doing (and the chance has passed).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 事故の原因は、運転手の不注意による{{c1::ものと思われます::it is thought (formal)}}。
tr: The accident is thought to have been caused by driver carelessness.
notes: Plain form + ものと思われる: it is thought; it seems likely (impersonal, formal).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N1::09 Sentence endings and set phrases
text: 台風は明日の朝、九州に上陸する{{c1::ものと思われます::it is thought (formal)}}。
tr: The typhoon is expected to make landfall in Kyushu tomorrow morning.
notes: Plain form + ものと思われる: it is thought; it seems likely (impersonal, formal).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 日本に{{c1::来て以来::来る · ever since}}、ずっと東京に住んでいます。
tr: Ever since I came to Japan, I've lived in Tokyo.
notes: て-form + 以来: ever since (and the state continues to now).
tip: vs てから: てから is just 'after'; 以来 stresses continuing up to now.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 大学を{{c1::卒業して以来::卒業する · ever since}}、彼に会っていません。
tr: I haven't seen him since we graduated.
notes: て-form + 以来: ever since (and the state continues to now).
tip: vs てから: てから is just 'after'; 以来 stresses continuing up to now.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 社長に{{c1::相談してからでないと::相談する · not until after}}、決められません。
tr: I can't decide until I've talked to the president.
notes: て-form + からでないと / からでなければ + negative: not until after; only after.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 料金を{{c1::払ってからでないと::払う · not until after}}、入れません。
tr: You can't go in until you've paid.
notes: て-form + からでないと / からでなければ + negative: not until after; only after.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text:
(As soon as) 結果が{{c1::わかり次第::わかる · as soon as or depends on?}}、ご連絡します。
(Depends on) 結果{{c2::次第で::as soon as or depends on?}}、計画を変えます。
tr: I'll contact you as soon as we know the results. / We'll change the plan depending on the results.
notes: Verb stem + 次第: as soon as (then I'll act; formal, about the future). Noun + 次第だ / 次第で: depends on.
tip: vs たとたん: たとたん is about something unexpected that already happened.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 準備が{{c1::でき次第::できる · as soon as}}、出発します。
tr: We'll leave as soon as we're ready.
notes: Verb stem + 次第: as soon as (then I'll act; formal, about the future). Noun + 次第だ / 次第で: depends on.
tip: vs たとたん: たとたん is about something unexpected that already happened.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 成功するかどうかは、努力{{c1::次第です::depends on}}。
tr: Whether you succeed depends on your effort.
notes: Verb stem + 次第: as soon as (then I'll act; formal, about the future). Noun + 次第だ / 次第で: depends on.
tip: vs たとたん: たとたん is about something unexpected that already happened.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 雨が{{c1::やんだかと思うと::やむ · no sooner … than}}、また降り出しました。
tr: No sooner had the rain stopped than it started again.
notes: Past た + かと思うと / かと思ったら: no sooner had A happened than B (something unexpected). Not used about your own actions.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 子どもは{{c1::帰ってきたかと思ったら::帰ってくる · no sooner … than}}、すぐ遊びに出かけました。
tr: The kids had barely got home before they went out to play.
notes: Past た + かと思うと / かと思ったら: no sooner had A happened than B (something unexpected). Not used about your own actions.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 留学{{c1::をきっかけに::with … as the trigger}}、料理を始めました。
tr: Studying abroad got me into cooking.
notes: Noun + をきっかけに: with X as the trigger; X prompted (a new start).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 病気{{c1::をきっかけに::with … as the trigger}}、たばこをやめました。
tr: Getting ill made me quit smoking.
notes: Noun + をきっかけに: with X as the trigger; X prompted (a new start).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 会議室を{{c1::使用する際は::使用する · when (formal)}}、受付に申し出てください。
tr: When using the meeting room, please tell reception.
notes: Dictionary form / past / noun + の + 際(に / は): when; on the occasion of (formal).
tip: vs とき: the same meaning, but 際 is formal (notices, business).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 日本に{{c1::いらっしゃった際には::いらっしゃる · when (formal)}}、ぜひご連絡ください。
tr: When you come to Japan, please do get in touch.
notes: Dictionary form / past / noun + の + 際(に / は): when; on the occasion of (formal).
tip: vs とき: the same meaning, but 際 is formal (notices, business).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: よく{{c1::考えた上で::考える · after (carefully) doing}}、決めてください。
tr: Please decide after thinking it over carefully.
notes: (a) Past た + 上で: after doing (and then, based on that). (b) Dictionary form + 上で: in doing; for the purpose of.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 外国語を{{c1::学ぶ上で::学ぶ · in doing}}、大切なことは何ですか。
tr: What's important when learning a foreign language?
notes: (a) Past た + 上で: after doing (and then, based on that). (b) Dictionary form + 上で: in doing; for the purpose of.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 工事{{c1::に先立って::prior to}}、説明会が行われました。
tr: A briefing was held before the construction started.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + に先立って: prior to; before (an event).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 試合{{c1::に先立って::prior to}}、開会式があります。
tr: There will be an opening ceremony before the match.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + に先立って: prior to; before (an event).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 地球の気温は{{c1::上がりつつあります::上がる · in the process of}}。
tr: Global temperatures are rising.
notes: Verb stem + つつある: is in the process of (a gradual change, now under way).
tip: vs ている: ている can be a completed state; つつある is a change in progress.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 町の様子は少しずつ{{c1::変わりつつあります::変わる · in the process of}}。
tr: The town is gradually changing.
notes: Verb stem + つつある: is in the process of (a gradual change, now under way).
tip: vs ている: ている can be a completed state; つつある is a change in progress.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 物価は{{c1::上がる一方です::上がる · keeps on (only)}}。
tr: Prices just keep going up.
notes: Dictionary form + 一方だ: keeps (only) going one way; more and more (often bad).
tip: Same meaning as ばかりだ.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::01 Time, sequence and change
text: 子どもの数は{{c1::減る一方です::減る · keeps on (only)}}。
tr: The number of children keeps falling.
notes: Dictionary form + 一方だ: keeps (only) going one way; more and more (often bad).
tip: Same meaning as ばかりだ.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 約束した{{c1::からには::now that (so must)}}、守らなければなりません。
tr: Now that you've promised, you have to keep it.
notes: Plain form + からには / 以上(は): now that; since (so you must / should). B is a duty, resolve or strong judgement.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 日本に{{c1::住む以上::住む · as long as (以上)}}、日本の法律を守るべきです。
tr: As long as you live in Japan, you should follow Japanese law.
notes: Plain form + からには / 以上(は): now that; since (so you must / should). B is a duty, resolve or strong judgement.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 富士山が見える{{c1::ことから::from the fact that}}、この町は「富士見町」と呼ばれています。
tr: Because you can see Mount Fuji from it, this town is called Fujimi-chō.
notes: Plain form + ことから: from the fact that (a basis for a name or a judgement).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 指紋が一致した{{c1::ことから::from the fact that}}、彼が犯人だとわかりました。
tr: From the fingerprints matching, they knew he was the culprit.
notes: Plain form + ことから: from the fact that (a basis for a name or a judgement).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: {{c1::心配のあまり::心配 · out of too much}}、夜も眠れませんでした。
tr: I was so worried I couldn't sleep at night.
notes: Noun + の / plain form + あまり: out of too much (a feeling); so … that (a bad result).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 緊張する{{c1::あまり::so (much) that}}、何も言えませんでした。
tr: I was so nervous I couldn't say anything.
notes: Noun + の / plain form + あまり: out of too much (a feeling); so … that (a bad result).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 一言{{c1::言ったばかりに::言う · just because (regret)}}、彼女を怒らせてしまいました。
tr: Just because I said one thing, I made her angry.
notes: Plain form + ばかりに: just because (of one thing), a bad result happened; regret.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: パスワードを{{c1::忘れたばかりに::忘れる · just because (regret)}}、何もできませんでした。
tr: Just because I forgot my password, I couldn't do anything.
notes: Plain form + ばかりに: just because (of one thing), a bad result happened; regret.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 寝不足の{{c1::せいか::perhaps because}}、頭が重いです。
tr: My head feels heavy, perhaps because I didn't sleep enough.
notes: Plain form / noun + の + せいか: perhaps because (an uncertain cause, usually of something bad).
tip: vs せいで: せいで states the cause with certainty.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 年の{{c1::せいか::perhaps because}}、最近よく物を忘れます。
tr: Maybe it's my age, but I keep forgetting things lately.
notes: Plain form / noun + の + せいか: perhaps because (an uncertain cause, usually of something bad).
tip: vs せいで: せいで states the cause with certainty.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 期待していた{{c1::だけに::all the more because}}、がっかりしました。
tr: I was all the more disappointed because I'd had high hopes.
notes: Plain form / noun + だけに: (a) precisely because (all the more); (b) as you'd expect, since.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 彼は留学していた{{c1::だけに::as you'd expect, since}}、英語が上手です。
tr: As you'd expect from someone who studied abroad, his English is good.
notes: Plain form / noun + だけに: (a) precisely because (all the more); (b) as you'd expect, since.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 電車が{{c1::遅れたものですから::遅れる · because (excuse)}}、遅刻してしまいました。
tr: I'm afraid the train was delayed, so I was late.
notes: Plain form + ものだから / もので: because (giving an excuse or a personal reason).
tip: vs から: から is neutral; もので sounds apologetic.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Japanese::N2::02 Cause, reason and basis
text: 急いでいた{{c1::もので::because (excuse)}}、かさを忘れてしまいました。
tr: I was in a hurry, so I forgot my umbrella.
notes: Plain form + ものだから / もので: because (giving an excuse or a personal reason).
tip: vs から: から is neutral; もので sounds apologetic.

text: 大学を{{c1::卒業したものの::卒業する · although}}、仕事が見つかりません。
tr: Although I graduated, I can't find a job.
notes: Plain form + ものの: although (the expected result didn't follow).
tip: vs けれども: ものの is written and stresses the gap between expectation and reality.

text: 頭ではわかっている{{c1::ものの::although}}、なかなかやめられません。
tr: Although I know it in my head, I just can't stop.
notes: Plain form + ものの: although (the expected result didn't follow).
tip: vs けれども: ものの is written and stresses the gap between expectation and reality.

text: 雨{{c1::にもかかわらず::despite}}、たくさんの人が集まりました。
tr: Despite the rain, lots of people came.
notes: Noun / plain form + にもかかわらず: despite; in spite of.
tip: vs のに: のに is emotional and spoken; にもかかわらず is formal.

text: 注意した{{c1::にもかかわらず::despite}}、彼はまた同じミスをしました。
tr: Despite being warned, he made the same mistake again.
notes: Noun / plain form + にもかかわらず: despite; in spite of.
tip: vs のに: のに is emotional and spoken; にもかかわらず is formal.

text: 高い{{c1::からといって::just because}}、いい物だとは限りません。
tr: Just because it's expensive doesn't mean it's good.
notes: Plain form + からといって + negative: just because … doesn't mean.

text: 日本人だ{{c1::からといって::just because}}、敬語が上手なわけではありません。
tr: Just because someone's Japanese doesn't mean they're good at keigo.
notes: Plain form + からといって + negative: just because … doesn't mean.

text: 料理ができる{{c1::といっても::although I say}}、簡単なものだけです。
tr: I say I can cook, but only simple things.
notes: Plain form / noun + といっても: although I say … (it's less than it sounds).

text: 旅行{{c1::といっても::although I say}}、一泊だけです。
tr: I call it a trip, but it's only one night.
notes: Plain form / noun + といっても: although I say … (it's less than it sounds).

text: 冗談{{c1::にしても::even if}}、言っていいことと悪いことがあります。
tr: Even if it's a joke, some things shouldn't be said.
notes: Noun / plain form + にしても (にしろ, にせよ): even if; even granting. A にしろ B にしろ: whether A or B.

text: 行く{{c1::にしろ::whether … or}}行かない{{c1::にしろ::whether … or}}、連絡してください。
tr: Whether you go or not, let me know.
notes: Noun / plain form + にしても (にしろ, にせよ): even if; even granting. A にしろ B にしろ: whether A or B.

text: この仕事は給料がいい{{c1::反面::on the other hand}}、休みが少ないです。
tr: This job pays well, but on the other hand there's little time off.
notes: Plain form + 反面 / 一方(で): but on the other hand (two sides of one thing).

text: 都会は便利な{{c1::一方で::while on the other hand}}、物価が高いです。
tr: Cities are convenient, but on the other hand things are expensive.
notes: Plain form + 反面 / 一方(で): but on the other hand (two sides of one thing).

text: {{c1::狭いながらも::狭い · although}}、楽しい我が家です。
tr: It may be small, but it's a happy home.
notes: Stem / い-adj / noun + ながら(も): although; despite being (a state, not an action).
tip: vs ながら (N4): 'while doing' two actions at once.

text: 子ども{{c1::ながら::although (just)}}、よくがんばりました。
tr: For a child, he did really well.
notes: Stem / い-adj / noun + ながら(も): although; despite being (a state, not an action).
tip: vs ながら (N4): 'while doing' two actions at once.

text: 体に悪いと{{c1::知りつつ::知る · while knowing (although)}}、たばこをやめられません。
tr: Even though I know it's bad for me, I can't quit smoking.
notes: Verb stem + つつ(も): although (knowing, feeling); while (doing). Often 知りつつ, 思いつつ.

text: 悪いと{{c1::思いつつも::思う · although (feeling)}}、うそをついてしまいました。
tr: Although I knew it was wrong, I lied.
notes: Verb stem + つつ(も): although (knowing, feeling); while (doing). Often 知りつつ, 思いつつ.

text: 予想{{c1::に反して::contrary to}}、試合は負けてしまいました。
tr: Contrary to expectations, we lost the match.
notes: Noun + に反して: contrary to (expectations, wishes, rules).

text: 親の期待{{c1::に反して::contrary to}}、彼は大学に行きませんでした。
tr: Against his parents' hopes, he didn't go to university.
notes: Noun + に反して: contrary to (expectations, wishes, rules).

text: 実際に{{c1::見ないことには::見る · unless}}、何とも言えません。
tr: I can't say anything until I actually see it.
notes: ない form + ことには + negative: unless (you do X, you can't…).

text: 社長が{{c1::来ないことには::来る · unless}}、会議が始められません。
tr: We can't start the meeting unless the president comes.
notes: ない form + ことには + negative: unless (you do X, you can't…).

text: {{c1::できるものなら::できる · if I could (unlikely)}}、もう一度学生に戻りたいです。
tr: If I could, I'd go back to being a student.
notes: (a) Potential form + ものなら: if I could (unlikely). (b) Volitional + ものなら: if you dare (a bad result follows).

text: 部長に{{c1::反対しようものなら::反対する · if you dare (bad result)}}、大変なことになります。
tr: If you so much as disagree with the manager, there'll be trouble.
notes: (a) Potential form + ものなら: if I could (unlikely). (b) Volitional + ものなら: if you dare (a bad result follows).

text: 私が{{c1::知っている限り::知る · as far as}}、彼はうそをつく人ではありません。
tr: As far as I know, he isn't someone who lies.
notes: (a) 知る / 見る + 限り: as far as. (b) Plain form + 限り(は): as long as. (c) ない form + 限り: unless.

text: 雨が{{c1::降らない限り::降る · unless}}、試合は行われます。
tr: Unless it rains, the match will go ahead.
notes: (a) 知る / 見る + 限り: as far as. (b) Plain form + 限り(は): as long as. (c) ない form + 限り: unless.

text: 体が{{c1::元気な限り::元気 · as long as}}、働きたいです。
tr: I want to keep working as long as I'm healthy.
notes: (a) 知る / 見る + 限り: as far as. (b) Plain form + 限り(は): as long as. (c) ない form + 限り: unless.

text: たとえ失敗した{{c1::としても::even if (hypothetical)}}、後悔しません。
tr: Even if I fail, I won't regret it.
notes: Plain form + としても: even if; even supposing (hypothetical).
tip: vs ても: としても stresses the hypothesis.

text: 今から{{c1::急いだとしても::急ぐ · even if}}、間に合わないでしょう。
tr: Even if we hurry now, we probably won't make it.
notes: Plain form + としても: even if; even supposing (hypothetical).
tip: vs ても: としても stresses the hypothesis.

text:
急いでいる時{{c1::に限って::に限って or に限らず?}}、電車が遅れます。
この店は若い人{{c2::に限らず::に限って or に限らず?}}、お年寄りにも人気があります。
tr: It's always when I'm in a hurry that the trains are late. / This place is popular not only with young people but with older people too.
notes: に限って: (of all times / people) only X (unluckily, unexpectedly). に限らず: not only X (it applies more widely).

text: 病気に{{c1::なってはじめて::なる · only after}}、健康の大切さがわかりました。
tr: Only after I got ill did I realise how important health is.
notes: て-form + はじめて: only after (did I realise / could I).

text: 一人で{{c1::暮らしてはじめて::暮らす · only after}}、家族のありがたさを知りました。
tr: Only after living alone did I appreciate my family.
notes: て-form + はじめて: only after (did I realise / could I).

text: この問題は、彼の協力{{c1::をぬきにしては::without}}解決できません。
tr: This problem can't be solved without his help.
notes: Noun + をぬきにして(は): without; leaving out (X is essential).

text: 日本の歴史は、中国との関係{{c1::をぬきにしては::without}}語れません。
tr: You can't talk about Japanese history without China.
notes: Noun + をぬきにして(は): without; leaving out (X is essential).

text: 遺産{{c1::をめぐって::over (dispute)}}、兄弟が争っています。
tr: The brothers are fighting over the inheritance.
notes: Noun + をめぐって: over; concerning (a dispute or debate).
tip: vs について: neutral 'about'; をめぐって implies disagreement.

text: 新しい空港の建設{{c1::をめぐって::over (debate)}}、意見が分かれています。
tr: Opinions are divided over building the new airport.
notes: Noun + をめぐって: over; concerning (a dispute or debate).
tip: vs について: neutral 'about'; をめぐって implies disagreement.

text: 料理{{c1::にかけては::when it comes to}}、彼女の右に出る人はいません。
tr: When it comes to cooking, no one beats her.
notes: Noun + にかけては: when it comes to (a skill; nobody beats them).

text: 足の速さ{{c1::にかけては::when it comes to}}、だれにも負けません。
tr: When it comes to running fast, I'm second to none.
notes: Noun + にかけては: when it comes to (a skill; nobody beats them).

text: 川{{c1::に沿って::along}}、桜の木が並んでいます。
tr: Cherry trees line the river.
notes: Noun + に沿って: (a) along (a river, road); (b) in line with (a plan, manual).

text: マニュアル{{c1::に沿って::in line with}}、作業を進めてください。
tr: Please carry out the work following the manual.
notes: Noun + に沿って: (a) along (a river, road); (b) in line with (a plan, manual).

text: この映画は事実{{c1::に基づいて::based on}}作られました。
tr: This film is based on a true story.
notes: Noun + に基づいて (に基づく + noun): based on.

text: アンケートの結果{{c1::に基づいて::based on}}、商品を改良しました。
tr: We improved the product based on the survey results.
notes: Noun + に基づいて (に基づく + noun): based on.

text: 駅{{c1::を中心に::centred on}}、町が広がっています。
tr: The town spreads out from the station.
notes: Noun + を中心に: centred on; mainly among.

text: 若者{{c1::を中心に::mainly among}}、人気が高まっています。
tr: It's growing in popularity, mainly among young people.
notes: Noun + を中心に: centred on; mainly among.

text: 友人{{c1::を通じて::through (via)}}、彼女と知り合いました。
tr: I met her through a friend.
notes: Noun + を通じて / を通して: (a) through; via (a means or person); (b) throughout (a period).
tip: vs にわたって: covering a long span or wide area.

text: この地方は一年{{c1::を通じて::throughout}}暖かいです。
tr: This region is warm all year round.
notes: Noun + を通じて / を通して: (a) through; via (a means or person); (b) throughout (a period).
tip: vs にわたって: covering a long span or wide area.

text: 会議は三時間{{c1::にわたって::over (a span of)}}続きました。
tr: The meeting went on for three hours.
notes: Time / place noun + にわたって (にわたる + noun): over; across (a whole span or range).

text: 台風は広い範囲{{c1::にわたって::across (a range)}}被害をもたらしました。
tr: The typhoon caused damage over a wide area.
notes: Time / place noun + にわたって (にわたる + noun): over; across (a whole span or range).

text: 社長{{c1::にかわって::on behalf of}}、私がごあいさつします。
tr: I'll give the greeting on behalf of the president.
notes: Noun + にかわって: (a) on behalf of; (b) in place of.

text: 最近は手紙{{c1::にかわって::in place of}}、メールが使われています。
tr: These days email is used instead of letters.
notes: Noun + にかわって: (a) on behalf of; (b) in place of.

text: 予算{{c1::に応じて::according to}}、メニューを選べます。
tr: You can choose a menu to suit your budget.
notes: Noun + に応じて: according to; in response to (adjusting to).

text: 能力{{c1::に応じて::according to}}、給料が決まります。
tr: Pay is set according to ability.
notes: Noun + に応じて: according to; in response to (adjusting to).

text: 去年{{c1::に比べて::compared with}}、今年は雪が多いです。
tr: There's more snow this year compared with last year.
notes: Noun + に比べて: compared with. Noun + に加えて: in addition to.

text: 雨{{c1::に加えて::in addition to}}、風も強くなってきました。
tr: On top of the rain, the wind has picked up too.
notes: Noun + に比べて: compared with. Noun + に加えて: in addition to.

text: 時代の変化{{c1::とともに::along with}}、言葉も変わります。
tr: Language changes along with the times.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + とともに: along with; as. にともなって: as a result of; accompanying (a change).

text: 人口の増加{{c1::にともなって::accompanying (as)}}、住宅が不足しています。
tr: As the population grows, there's a housing shortage.
notes: Noun / dictionary form + とともに: along with; as. にともなって: as a result of; accompanying (a change).

text: 開会{{c1::に際して::on the occasion of}}、一言ごあいさつ申し上げます。
tr: On the opening of this event, allow me to say a few words.
notes: Noun + に際して: on the occasion of (formal). Noun + をはじめ: starting with; including (a leading example).

text: 東京{{c1::をはじめ::starting with}}、全国の都市で発売されます。
tr: It goes on sale in cities across the country, starting with Tokyo.
notes: Noun + に際して: on the occasion of (formal). Noun + をはじめ: starting with; including (a leading example).

text: 母の料理{{c1::ほど::nothing is as … as}}おいしいものはありません。
tr: Nothing tastes as good as my mother's cooking.
notes: N ほど + adjective + N はない: nothing is as … as N.

text: 健康{{c1::ほど::nothing is as … as}}大切なものはありません。
tr: Nothing is as important as health.
notes: N ほど + adjective + N はない: nothing is as … as N.

text: 途中でやめる{{c1::くらいなら::rather than}}、最初からやらないほうがいいです。
tr: Rather than give up halfway, it's better not to start.
notes: Dictionary form + くらいなら: rather than (do X, I'd prefer Y).

text: あんな人と結婚する{{c1::くらいなら::rather than}}、一生一人でいます。
tr: I'd rather stay single all my life than marry someone like that.
notes: Dictionary form + くらいなら: rather than (do X, I'd prefer Y).

text:
(The opposite happened) 薬を飲んだが、よくなる{{c1::どころか::どころか or ばかりか?}}、悪くなりました。
(Adding more) 彼は英語{{c2::ばかりか::どころか or ばかりか?}}、フランス語も話せます。
tr: I took the medicine, but far from getting better, I got worse. / He speaks not only English but French too.
notes: どころか: far from it (the opposite is true, or not even the lesser thing). ばかりか: not only (adding something bigger in the same direction).

text: 忙しくて、旅行{{c1::どころか::どころか or ばかりか?}}、週末も休めません。
tr: I'm so busy that, far from travelling, I can't even rest at weekends.
notes: どころか: far from it (the opposite is true, or not even the lesser thing). ばかりか: not only (adding something bigger in the same direction).

text: この店は、味{{c1::はもちろん::not to mention}}、サービスもいいです。
tr: The food here is great, not to mention the service.
notes: Noun + はもちろん / はもとより: not to mention; of course … and also. もとより is more formal.

text: 彼は日本語{{c1::はもとより::not to mention (formal)}}、英語も中国語も話せます。
tr: He speaks Japanese, of course, and English and Chinese as well.
notes: Noun + はもちろん / はもとより: not to mention; of course … and also. もとより is more formal.

text: 好きな{{c1::だけ::as much as}}食べてください。
tr: Eat as much as you like.
notes: Verb / adjective + だけ: as much as (できるだけ = as … as possible; 好きなだけ = as much as you like).

text: できる{{c1::だけ::as much as (possible)}}早く来てください。
tr: Please come as early as you can.
notes: Verb / adjective + だけ: as much as (できるだけ = as … as possible; 好きなだけ = as much as you like).

text: それはただのうわさ{{c1::に過ぎません::no more than}}。
tr: That's no more than a rumour.
notes: Noun / plain form + に過ぎない: no more than; merely.

text: 私は社員の一人{{c1::に過ぎません::no more than}}。
tr: I'm just one of the employees.
notes: Noun / plain form + に過ぎない: no more than; merely.

text: 言う{{c1::までもなく::it goes without saying}}、健康がいちばん大切です。
tr: It goes without saying that health comes first.
notes: Dictionary form + までもない: there's no need to (it's obvious). 言うまでもなく: it goes without saying.
tip: vs ことはない: no need (reassurance); までもない stresses that it's obvious.

text: この程度のけがなら、病院に行く{{c1::までもありません::no need to (obvious)}}。
tr: For an injury this minor, there's no need to go to hospital.
notes: Dictionary form + までもない: there's no need to (it's obvious). 言うまでもなく: it goes without saying.
tip: vs ことはない: no need (reassurance); までもない stresses that it's obvious.

text: 合格の知らせを聞いて、どんなに{{c1::うれしかったことか::うれしい · how …! (past)}}。
tr: How happy I was to hear I'd passed!
notes: どんなに / 何度 + plain form + ことか: how (very)…! (exclamation).

text: 何度{{c1::注意したことか::注意する · how many times …!}}。
tr: How many times have I told you!
notes: どんなに / 何度 + plain form + ことか: how (very)…! (exclamation).

text: (To a friend) そんなの、うそ{{c1::に決まっている::bound to be}}よ。
tr: That's obviously a lie.
notes: Plain form + に決まっている (nouns and な-adj drop だ): certainly; bound to be (a confident, subjective judgement).
tip: vs に違いない: に違いない is more written; に決まっている is conversational.

text: こんなに練習したんだから、勝つ{{c1::に決まっています::bound to}}。
tr: We've practised this much, so we're bound to win.
notes: Plain form + に決まっている (nouns and な-adj drop だ): certainly; bound to be (a confident, subjective judgement).
tip: vs に違いない: に違いない is more written; に決まっている is conversational.

text: (To a friend) あんな店、二度と{{c1::行くものか::行く · no way (never)}}。
tr: I'll never go to that place again.
notes: Dictionary form + ものか (casual: もんか): no way; never (a strong denial).

text: (To a friend) あんな人に{{c1::負けるものか::負ける · no way (never)}}。
tr: There's no way I'll lose to someone like that.
notes: Dictionary form + ものか (casual: もんか): no way; never (a strong denial).

text:
(An urge) その映画を見て、{{c1::泣かずにはいられませんでした::泣く · ずにはいられない or ざるを得ない?}}。
(No choice) 台風なので、旅行を{{c2::中止せざるを得ません::中止する · ずにはいられない or ざるを得ない?}}。
tr: I couldn't help crying at that film. / Because of the typhoon, we have no choice but to cancel the trip.
notes: ずにはいられない: can't help doing (an urge). ざるを得ない: have no choice but to (a reluctant obligation). する → せずには / せざるを得ない.

text: 試験の結果が{{c1::気になってしかたがありません::気になる · unbearably}}。
tr: I can't stop worrying about the exam results.
notes: て-form + しかたがない / たまらない / ならない: unbearably; extremely (a feeling or physical sensation).
tip: てならない is more written.

text: のどが{{c1::かわいてたまりません::かわく · unbearably}}。
tr: I'm terribly thirsty.
notes: て-form + しかたがない / たまらない / ならない: unbearably; extremely (a feeling or physical sensation).
tip: てならない is more written.

text: 台風が上陸する{{c1::おそれがあります::there's a risk}}。
tr: There's a risk the typhoon will make landfall.
notes: Dictionary form / noun + の + おそれがある: there's a risk of (something bad).

text: この薬は眠くなる{{c1::おそれがあります::there's a risk}}。
tr: This medicine may cause drowsiness.
notes: Dictionary form / noun + の + おそれがある: there's a risk of (something bad).

text:
(Polite refusal) その質問にはお答え{{c1::しかねます::する · かねる or かねない?}}。
(A bad possibility) そんなに飲んだら、病気に{{c2::なりかねません::なる · かねる or かねない?}}。
tr: I'm afraid I can't answer that question. / If you drink that much, you could well get ill.
notes: Verb stem + かねる: can't (polite refusal; would find it difficult). Verb stem + かねない: might well (something bad).
tip: The negative-looking かねない is actually the positive 'might'.

text: (To a friend) こんな難しい問題、{{c1::わかりっこない::わかる · no way (casual)}}よ。
tr: There's no way I can understand a question this hard.
notes: Verb stem + っこない: no way; there's no chance (casual).

text: (To a friend) 今から行っても、{{c1::間に合いっこない::間に合う · no way (casual)}}。
tr: Even if we go now, there's no way we'll make it.
notes: Verb stem + っこない: no way; there's no chance (casual).

text: それは十分{{c1::あり得る::ある · possible}}ことです。
tr: That's entirely possible.
notes: Verb stem + 得る (うる / える): can happen; possible. 得ない (えない): impossible.

text: そんなことは{{c1::あり得ません::ある · impossible}}。
tr: That's impossible.
notes: Verb stem + 得る (うる / える): can happen; possible. 得ない (えない): impossible.

text: もう二度とうそは{{c1::つくまい::つく · will never (resolve)}}と思いました。
tr: I resolved never to lie again.
notes: Dictionary form + まい: (a) will never (a strong resolution); (b) probably not (written).

text: (Written) 彼はもう{{c1::来るまい::来る · probably won't (written)}}。
tr: He probably won't come now.
notes: Dictionary form + まい: (a) will never (a strong resolution); (b) probably not (written).

text: 電車がないので、歩いて帰る{{c1::しかありません::no choice but}}。
tr: There are no trains, so I've no choice but to walk home.
notes: Dictionary form + しかない / ほかない: have no choice but to. ほかない is more formal.
tip: vs ざるを得ない: similar, more written.

text: 誰も手伝ってくれないなら、自分でやる{{c1::ほかありません::no choice but (formal)}}。
tr: If nobody will help, I have no choice but to do it myself.
notes: Dictionary form + しかない / ほかない: have no choice but to. ほかない is more formal.
tip: vs ざるを得ない: similar, more written.

text: 上手になりたければ、毎日練習する{{c1::ことです::you should (advice)}}。
tr: If you want to get better, practise every day.
notes: Dictionary form + ことだ: you should (personal advice). Dictionary form + ものではない: one shouldn't (a social norm).

text: 人の悪口を言う{{c1::ものではありません::one shouldn't (norm)}}。
tr: One shouldn't speak badly of others.
notes: Dictionary form + ことだ: you should (personal advice). Dictionary form + ものではない: one shouldn't (a social norm).

text: 子どものとき、母に野菜を{{c1::食べさせられました::食べる · was made to}}。

notes: Causative + passive: be made to do (against your will). る-verb: させられる. う-verb: a-row + せられる, usually shortened to a-row + される (飲まされる). する → させられる. 来る → 来させられる. Verbs ending in す can't use the short form (話させられる).
tip: vs passive: something is done to you; causative-passive: you are made to do it.

tip: vs passive: something is done to you; causative-passive: you are made to do it.
